caption: The drawing depicts a wooden rocking chair positioned centrally against a plain, light-colored background. The chair is rendered in shades of dark brown, with visible wood grain details throughout its surface. The chair features a straight back with two horizontal slats near the top and three vertical, narrow, decorative spindles connecting the seat to the upper slat. The seat is broad and flat, with slightly angled edges, and the chair rests on four legs, each supported by a stretcher connecting the front and back legs on each side. The lower part of the chair consists of two curved rockers attached to the legs, and an additional stretcher spans between the two rockers. The overall perspective of the drawing is from the front, providing a clear and symmetrical view of the entire chair. The background is blank, drawing attention entirely to the chair and its details.
title: Shaker Nursing Chair
